verses.text: And I ſavv one Angel ſtanding in the ſunne, & he cried vvith a loud voice ſaying to al the birdes that did flie by the middes of heauen, Come and aſſemble together to the great ſupper of God:

that you may eate the fleſh of kings, and the fleſh of tribunes, and the fleſh of valiants, and the fleſh of horſes & of them that ſit on them, & the fleſh of al freemen and bondmen, and of litle and great.
And I ſavv the beaſt and the kings of the earth, & their armies gathered to make vvarre vvith him that ſate vpon the horſe and vvith his armie.

And the beaſt vvas apprehended, and vvith him the falſe-prophet: vvhich vvrought ſignes before him, vvherevvith he ſeduced them that tooke the character of the beaſt, and that adored his image. Theſe tvvo were caſt aliue into the poole of fire burning alſo with brimſtone.
And the reſt vvere ſlaine by the ſvvord of him that ſitteth vpon the horſe, vvhich procedeth out of his mouth: and al the birdes vvere filled vvith their fleſh.

chapters.summary: 1 The Saincts glorifying God for the iudgement pronounced vpon the harlot, 7 the mariage of the Lambe is prepared. 10 The Angel refuſeth to be adored of S. Iohn. 11 There appeareth one ( vvho is the word of God, and the King of kings and Lord of lords ) ſitting on a horſe, vvith a great armie, and fighting againſt the beaſt and the kings of the earth and their armies: 17 the birdes of the aire being in the meane time called to deuoure their fleſh.

verses.text: AND I ſavv an Angel deſcending from heauen, hauing the key of the bottomles depth, and a great chaine in his hand.

notes.text: See in S. Auguſtine ( li. 20. de Ciuit. c. 7. 8. & ſeq. ) the expoſition of this chapter.

verses.text: And he apprehended the dragon the old ſerpent, vvhich is the Deuil and Satan, and bound him for a thouſand yeres.

and he threvv him into the depth, and ſhut him vp, and ſealed ouer him, that he ſeduce no more the nations, til the thouſand yeres be conſummate. and after theſe thinges he muſt be looſed a litle time.

And I ſavv ſeates: and they ſate vpon them, & iudgement vvas giuen them, and the ſoules of the beheaded for the teſtimonie of IESVS, and for the vvord of God, and that adored not the beaſt, nor his image, nor receiued his character in their foreheads or in their handes, and haue liued, and reigned vvith Chriſt a thouſand yeres.

notes.text: Quid in millenario numero niſi ad proferendam nouam ſobolem perfecta vniuerſitas præſcita generationis exprimitur? hinc per Ioannem dicitur, Et regnabunt cum illo mille annis, quia regnum ſanctæ Eccleſiæ, vniuerſitatis perfectione ſolidatur. D. Gregor. li. 9. Moral. c. 1.

verses.text: The reſt of the dead liued not, til the thouſand yeres be conſummate. This is the firſt reſurrection.
Bleſſed and holy is he that hath part in the firſt reſurrection. in theſe the ſecond death hath not povver: but they ſhal be prieſtes of God and of Chriſt: and ſhal reigne vvith him a thouſand yeres.

And vvhen the thouſand yeres ſhal be conſummate, Satan ſhal be looſed out of his priſon, and ſhal goe forth, and ſeduce the nations that are vpon the foure corners of the earth, Gog, and Magog, and ſhal gather them into battel, the number of vvhom is as the ſand of the ſea.

notes.text: Ezec. 38, 14. 39, 2. · S. Auguſtine thinketh that theſe do not ſignifie any certaine nations but al that ſhal then be ioyned vvith the Diuel and Antichriſt againſt the Church. li. 20. de Ciuit. c. 11. See S. Hierom in Ezech. li. 11.

verses.text: And they aſcended vpon the bredth of the earth, and compaſſed the campe of the Sainctes, and the beloued citie.
And there came dovvne fire from God out of heauen, and deuoured them:
and the Deuil vvhich ſeduced them, vvas caſt into the poole of fire and brimſtone, vvhere both the beaſt and the falſe-prophet ſhal be tormented day and night for euer and euer.
And I ſavv a great vvhite throne, and one ſitting vpon it, from vvhoſe ſight earth and heauen fled, and there vvas no place found for them.

notes.text: THE 6 VISION.
They ſhal then be new, not the ſubſtance, but the ſhape changed. 2 Pet. 3. See S. Auguſtine. li. 20. de Ciuit. c. 14.

verses.text: And I ſavv the dead, great and litle, ſtanding in the ſight of the throne, and bookes vvere opened: and an other booke vvas opened, vvhich is of life: and the dead vvere iudged of thoſe thinges vvhich were vvritten in the bookes according to their vvorkes.

notes.text: c The books of men's conſciences, where it ſhal plainly be read what euery man's life hath been.

verses.text: and the ſea gaue the dead that vvere in it, and death and hel gaue their dead that vvere in them, and it vvas iudged of euery one according to their vvorkes.
And hel and death vvere caſt into the poole of fire. This is the ſecond death.
And he that vvas not found vvritten in the booke of life, vvas caſt into the poole of fire.

notes.text: Such as doe no good workes, if they haue age and time to doe them, are not found in the booke of life.

chapters.summary: An Angel caſteth the dragon ( or diuel ) bound, into the depth for a thouſand yeres, in vvhich the ſoules of martyrs in the firſt reſurrection ſhal raigne vvith Chriſt. 7 After vvhich yeres, Satan being let looſe, ſhal raiſe Gog and Magog, an innumerable armie, againſt the beloued citie: 9 but a fire from heauen ſhal deſtroy them. 12 Then bookes are opened, and he that ſitteth vpon the throne, iudgeth al the dead according to their vvorkes.

verses.text: AND I ſavv a nevv heauen and a nevv earth. for the firſt heauen, and the firſt earth vvas gone, & the ſea novv is not.
And I Iohn ſavv the holy citie Hieruſalem nevv deſcending from heauen, prepared of God, as a bride adorned for her huſband.

notes.text: The Epiſtle vpon the dedication of a Church.
The Church triumphant.

verses.text: And I heard a loud voice from the throne ſaying: Behold the tabernacle of God vvith men, and he vvil dvvel vvith them. And they ſhal be his people: and he God vvith them ſhal be their God.

notes.text: This tabernacle is Chriſt according to his humanitie.

verses.text: and God ſhal vvipe avvay al teares from their eies: and death ſhal be no more. nor mourning, nor crying, neither ſhal there be ſorovv any more, vvhich firſt thinges are gone.

notes.text: c This happie day ſhal make an end of all the miſeries of this mortalitie.
becauſe the

verses.text: And he that ſate in the throne, ſaid: Behold I make al thinges nevv. ⊢ And he ſaid to me: Vvrite, becauſe theſe vvordes be moſt faithful and true.
And he ſaid to me: It is done, I am Alpha and O mega: the beginning and the end. To him that thirſteth I vvil giue of the fountaine of the vvater of life, gratis.
He that ſhal ouercome, ſhal poſſeſſe theſe thinges, and I vvil be his God: and he ſhal be my ſonne.

notes.text: He that hath the victorie againſt ſinne in the Church militant, ſhal haue his revvard in the triumphant.

verses.text: But to the feareful, and incredulous, and execrable, and murderers, and fornicators, and ſorcerers, and Idolaters, and al liers, their part ſhal be in the poole burning vvith fire and brimſtone, vvhich is the ſecond death.

notes.text: Al that commit mortal ſinnes and repent not, ſhal be damned.

verses.text: And there came one of the ſeuen Angels that had the vials ful of the ſeuen laſt plagues, and ſpake vvith me, ſaying: Come, & I vvil ſhevv thee the bride, the vvife of the Lambe.

notes.text: THE 7 AND LAST VISION.

verses.text: And he tooke me vp in ſpirit vnto a mountaine great and high: and he ſhevved me the holy citie Hieruſalem deſcending out of heauen from God, hauing the glorie of God.
and the light thereof like to a pretious ſtone, as it vvere to the iaſper ſtone, euen as cryſtal.

notes.text: The glory of the Church triumphant.

verses.text: And it had a vvall great and high, hauing tvvelue gates, and in the gates tvvelue Angels, & names written thereon, vvhich are the names of the tvvelue tribes of the children of Iſrael.

notes.text: The names of the Patriarches and Apoſtles honorable and glorious in the triumphant Church.

verses.text: On the Eaſt, three gates: and on the North, three gates: and on the South, three gates: and on the Vveſt, three gates.
And the vvall of the citie hauing tvvelue foundations: and in them, tvvelue names, of the tvvelue Apoſtles of the Lambe.
And he that ſpake vvith me, had a meaſure of a reede, of gold, to meaſure the citie and the gates thereof, and the vvall.

And the citie is ſituated quadrangle-vviſe, and the length thereof is as great as alſo the bredth: and he meaſured the citie vvith the reede for tvvelue thouſand furlonges, & the length and height and bredth thereof be equal.

notes.text: See S. Hierom ep. 17. touching this deſcription of the heauenly Hieruſalem, vvhich is the Church triumphant, teaching that theſe things muſt be taken ſpiritually, not carnally.

verses.text: And he meaſured the vvall thereof of an hundred fourtie foure cubites, the meaſure of a man vvhich is of an Angel.
And the building of the vvall therof vvas of iaſper ſtone: but the citie it ſelf pure gold, like to pure glaſſe.
And the foundations of the vvall of the citie, vvere adorned vvith al pretious ſtone. The firſt foundation, the iaſper: the ſecond, the ſaphire: the third, the calcedonius: the fourth, the emerauld:

the fifth, the ſardonix: the ſixt, the ſardius: the ſeuenth, the chryſolithus: the eight, the beryllus: the ninthe, the topazius: the tenth, the chryſopraſus: the eleuenth, the hyacinthe: the tvvelfth, the amethyſte.
And the twelue gates: there are tvvelue pearles, one to euery one: & euery gate vvas of one ſeueral pearle. & the ſtreate of the citie pure gold, as it vvere tranſparent glaſſe.
And temple I ſavv not therein. for our Lord the God omnipotent is the temple thereof, and the Lambe.

notes.text: Al external ſacrifice which now is neceſſarie dutie of the faithful, ſhal then ceaſe and therfore there ſhal neede no material temple.

verses.text: And the citie needeth not ſunne nor moone, to ſhine in it. for the glorie of God hath illuminated it, and the Lambe is the lampe thereof.
And the Gentiles ſhal vvalke in the light of it: and the kinges of the earth ſhal bring their glorie and honour into it.
And the gates thereof ſhal not be ſhut by day: for there ſhal be no night there.
And they ſhal bring the glorie and honour of nations into it.
There ſhal not enter into it any polluted thing, nor that doeth abomination and maketh lie, but they that are vvritten in the booke of life of the Lambe.

notes.text: None not perfectly cleanſed of their ſins, can enter into this heauenly Hieruſalem.

chapters.summary: Heauen and earth being made nevv, S. Iohn ſeeth the nevv citie Hieruſalem prepared and adorned for the ſpouſe of the Lambe. 6 The iuſt are glorified, 7 and the vvicked thruſt into the poole of fire. 12 The vvall and gates and foundations of the citie are deſcribed and meaſured: 18 al vvhich are gold and cryſtal, pretious ſtones and pearles.

summary_notes.text: The final glorification of the Church.

verses.text: AND he ſhevved me a riuer of liuing water, cleere as cryſtal, proceding from the ſeate of God and of the Lambe.

notes.text: vvater of life,

verses.text: In the middes of the ſtreate thereof, and on both ſides of the riuer, the tree of life, yelding tvvelue fruites, rendring his fruite euery moneth, and the leaues of the tree for the curing of the Gentiles.

notes.text: Chriſt is our tree of life: in the Church, by the B. Sacramēt: & in heauen, by his viſible preſence and influence of life euerlaſting both to our bodies and ſoules: of vvhō Salomon ſaith, The tree of life to al that apprehend him. Prou. 3.

verses.text: And no curſe ſhal be any more: and the ſeate of God and of the Lambe ſhal be in it, and his ſeruantes ſhal ſerue him.
And they ſhal ſee his face: and his name in their foreheads.
And night ſhal be no more: and they ſhal not neede the light of lampe, nor the light of the ſunne, becauſe our Lord God doth illuminate them, and they ſhal reigne for euer and euer.
And he ſaid to me, Theſe vvordes are moſt faithful and true. And our Lord the God of the ſpirites of the prophetes, ſent his Angel to ſhevv his ſeruantes thoſe thinges vvhich muſt be done quickly.

notes.text: THE CONCLVSION.

verses.text: And behold I come quickly. Bleſſed is he that keepeth the vvordes of the prophecie of this booke.
And I Iohn vvhich haue heard, and ſeen theſe thinges. And after I had heard and ſeen, I fel dovvne to adore before the feete of the Angel vvhich ſhevved me theſe thinges:

notes.text: You ſee it is al one to adore before the feete of the angel, & to adore the Angel: though, to adore him, be not expreſſed as in the 19 chap. See the anōtatiō there v. 10.

verses.text: and he ſaid to me, See thou doe not, for I am thy fellow-ſeruant, and of thy brethren the prophetes, and of them that keepe the vvordes of this booke. Adore God.
And he ſaith to me, Seale not the vvordes of the prophecie of this booke. for the time is neere.
He that hurteth, let him hurt yet: and he that is in filth, let him be filthie yet: and he that is iuſt, let him be iuſtified yet: and let the holy be ſanctified yet.

notes.text: Man by Gods grace & doing good vvorkes, doth increaſe his iuſtice.

verses.text: Behold I come quickly. and my revvard is vvith me, to render to euery man according to his vvorkes,

notes.text: Heauen is the revvard, hire, & repaiment for good vvorkes, in al the Scriptures. yet the aduerſaries vvil not ſee it.

verses.text: I am Alpha and O mega, the firſt and the laſt, the beginning and the end.
Bleſſed are they that vvaſh their ſtoles: that their povver may be in the tree of life, and they may enter by the gates into the citie.
Vvithout are dogges and ſorcerers, and the vnchaſt, and murderers, and ſeruers of Idols, & euery one that loueth and maketh a lie.
I IESVS haue ſent mine Angel, to teſtifie to you theſe thinges in the Churches. I am the roote and ſtocke of Dauid, the bright and morning ſtarre.
And the Spirit & the bride ſay, Come. And he that heareth, let him ſay, Come. And he that thirſteth, let him come: and he that vvil, let him take the vvater of life gratis.
For I teſtifie to euery one hearing the vvordes of the prophecie of this booke, If any man ſhal adde to theſe things, God ſhal adde vpon him the plagues vvritten in this booke.

And if any man ſhal diminiſh of the wordes of the booke of this prophecie: God ſhal take avvay his part out of the booke of life, and out of the holy citie, and of theſe thinges that be vvritten in this booke.
ſaith he that giueth teſtimonie of theſe things. Yea I come quickely: Amen. Come Lord IESVS.
The grace of our Lord IESVS Chriſt be vvith you al. Amen.

chapters.summary: The tree of life being vvatered vvith liuing vvater, yeldeth fruictes euery moneth. 3 There is neither curſe nor night in the citie. 6 The Angel that ſhevved Iohn al theſe thinges, refuſeth to be adored of him. 14 He telleth him that the iuſt ſhal enter into the citie, but the reſt ſhal be caſt forth. 18 Laſtly, he proteſteth and threateneth againſt them that ſhal preſume to adde to this prophecie, or take avvay from the ſame.
